```python
from picogrid_ecn_client import ReconnectPolicy
```

Configure one bounded exponential reconnect policy with mandatory full jitter.

```python
ReconnectPolicy(
    *,
    initial_delay_seconds: float = 0.5,
    multiplier: float = 2.0,
    maximum_delay_seconds: float = 30.0,
    stable_reset_seconds: float = 60.0,
    maximum_attempts: int | None = None,
    maximum_elapsed_seconds: float | None = None,
)
```

[Source · config.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/config.py#L68)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| initial_delay_seconds | float | no | 0.5 | `gt=0`, `finite` | Positive finite initial retry-delay cap in seconds. |
| multiplier | float | no | 2.0 | `ge=1`, `finite` | Finite exponential retry multiplier greater than or equal to one. |
| maximum_delay_seconds | float | no | 30.0 | `gt=0`, `finite` | Positive finite maximum full-jitter delay cap in seconds; not below initial_delay_seconds. |
| stable_reset_seconds | float | no | 60.0 | `gt=0`, `finite` | Positive finite strict-ready duration before attempt and elapsed budgets reset. |
| maximum_attempts | int \| None | no | None | `ge=1` | Optional positive maximum attempts in one recovery episode. |
| maximum_elapsed_seconds | float \| None | no | None | `gt=0`, `finite` | Optional positive finite elapsed-time limit for one recovery episode. |
